applications.name: Cuatro Ecosystem
applications.description: The front door to the suite. It lists the applications in the Ecosystem, says what each one does, and links to where its source lives.

applications.name: Cuatro Tracker
applications.description: A self-hosted tracker for movies, TV shows, anime, manga and video games. Every entry sits on one timeline ordered by release date, so the five kinds are read together rather than as separate lists.

applications.name: CS Tracker
applications.description: Tracks Counter-Strike 2 skins. It carries a catalog of items, syncs a Steam inventory, holds a wishlist with target prices, and follows what each item sells for across several marketplaces.

applications.name: Digital Library
applications.description: A self-hosted library for ebooks and comics. It reads EPUB, PDF and CBZ in the browser, finds a title by full-text search, and can send one to a Kindle.

applications.name: CS Tournament
applications.description: Runs a Counter-Strike tournament from sign-up through the bracket to a final result.

applications.name: List Wheel
applications.description: Turns any list into a wheel and picks one entry at random.

applications.name: Cuatro Finance
applications.description: A self-hosted personal finance application for Colombian accounts, covering expense tracking, budgets, debt payoff and investments across pesos, dollars and crypto. It reads transactions from connected banks and forecasts cash flow.

applications.name: StreamVault
applications.description: A self-hosted stream recorder. It watches a list of streamers, starts recording the moment one goes live, and collects the results in a library that can be browsed, played and pruned.

applications.name: MaiCoin
applications.description: A learning project that walks an ERC-20 token through its whole life, from writing the contract to a dashboard where connected wallets can check balances, send tokens and watch them being minted and burned. It runs on a test network rather than the main one, so no real money is involved.

applications.name: PokéTracker GO
applications.description: A Pokémon GO companion for completionists: a Pokédex tracker covering every catchable variant, paired with a watchlist. A rule added to the watchlist tells a bot which spawn announcements to watch for, and a phone alert follows when one matches.

applications.name: Mutuo
applications.description: A therapy platform connecting patients with licensed therapists. It covers the path from finding a match to booking an appointment, meeting over encrypted video, and keeping notes and assigned work afterwards, with separate portals for patients, therapists and administrators.

applications.name: Lumen
applications.description: A desktop Markdown note-taking application for developers working inside WSL2, keeping its notes in a git repository and committing them without leaving the editor. It was never built: the repository holds no code, and it is archived.

applications.name: TCG Tracker
applications.description: A trading card game collection tracker. It was never built, and the idea is set to fold into Cuatro Tracker as one of its domains.

applications.name: Connect Four
applications.description: A browser version of Connect Four, played against the computer or against another person at the same screen. It is retired as a standalone application, and the game is set to be rebuilt inside the Cuatro Ecosystem hub.
